meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: The RBI's tables are final as printed except household financial flows, which are preliminary and revised as more data arrive; the latest print of each period is kept and earlier ones stay in the raw archive.
meta.product: DBIE report 17 (RBI Bulletin table 21: monthly average price of gold and silver)
meta.coverage: The price of gold and silver in Mumbai and abroad, monthly averages since April 1990
meta.note: Monthly averages. The spread is the Mumbai price less the overseas price converted to rupees: what import duty, taxes and local demand add. The source's Item Code column is misaligned with its descriptions; series follow the descriptions, which the values confirm.
